doctrine: Keys replay SELECTION, never authorization. Money/irreversible steps re-resolve their gate at replay time.

1.name: GO
1.acts: List the READY set as orders. Agent drains them; H-tasks surface on block.

2.name: ZOOM
2.acts: Achieved-vs-missing across queue, humans, goal, budget. Read-only.

3.name: DIG
3.acts: Show current blockers (open humans + NOGO reasons). Bounded, read-only.

4.name: PICK
4.acts: Answer the open choice task with option N.

5.name: OK
5.acts: Approve the first open human task. Money re-opens its gate, never inherits.

6.name: NO
6.acts: Deny the first open human task; the A-task replans around it.

7.name: TELL
7.acts: Answer the open input task with text. Key-shaped input refused.

9.name: FIX
9.acts: File a correction (bare = auto-context; +text = directed). Feeds the next plan.

0.name: STOP
0.acts: Halt (writes HALT.json) or resume (lifts it). Read-only keys 2,3,8 still work under halt.

grammar: Digits are verbs. Only 4 consumes a following digit as its argument. 7 and 9 open text capture. Anything else is a ValueError, never a guess.
never_autonomous: Any M-route step, money-5 with amount, key-shaped TELL payloads. Hard exclusion, not a threshold.
